title: Rebuild Tesla marketplace with car listings and authentication

requirements.text: Fix the Cars page to properly display the Tesla car inventory with model images, specifications, pricing, and functional buy buttons that navigate to the payment page

quotes: Rebuild the Tesla marketplace (focusing on car listings and authentication first)

acceptanceCriteria: The /cars route displays a grid of Tesla vehicles
Each car card shows the model name, image, specifications, and price
Buy buttons are functional and navigate to the payment page with the correct VIN
Scroll-triggered animations work as designed

requirements.text: Fix the signup page to properly register new users with Internet Identity authentication and create user profiles in the backend

quotes: Rebuild the Tesla marketplace (focusing on car listings and authentication first)

acceptanceCriteria: Users can click signup and authenticate with Internet Identity
New users are prompted with the profile setup modal
User profiles are successfully saved to the backend with principal ID and timestamp
After signup, users are redirected to the cars page

requirements.text: Fix the login page to properly authenticate existing users with Internet Identity and load their profiles from the backend

quotes: Rebuild the Tesla marketplace (focusing on car listings and authentication first)

acceptanceCriteria: Users can authenticate with Internet Identity on the login page
Existing user profiles are loaded from the backend
New users see the profile setup modal
After login, users are redirected to the cars page

requirements.text: Ensure the backend actor properly handles getUserProfile, saveUserProfile, and getInventory queries with appropriate error handling

quotes: Rebuild the Tesla marketplace (focusing on car listings and authentication first)

acceptanceCriteria: getUserProfile returns existing profiles or null for new users
saveUserProfile creates new profiles with principal ID and timestamp
getInventory returns the full list of Tesla vehicles with specifications and pricing
All backend queries handle authentication correctly

requirements.text: Fix the header navigation to properly display Login/Signup links for unauthenticated users and User Profile link for authenticated users

quotes: Rebuild the Tesla marketplace (focusing on car listings and authentication first)

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users see Login and Signup links in the header
Authenticated users see User Profile link instead of Login/Signup
Admin users see the Admin link in addition to User Profile
All navigation links are functional and route correctly

constraints: Use Internet Identity for all authentication
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
Keep all existing Tesla branding and visual theme
